The edge of the front-most slice appears to crumble into indistinct mush rather than maintaining a clean cut edge or natural crumb structure, suggesting a slight failure in simulating rigid food physics.

To analyze the realism of the grease sheen, glaze viscosity, and meat grain, which are common failure points in AI-generated food images.
To verify if the glaze sits naturally on top of the meat or if there is unnatural blending/fusion at the interface.

Consistency of the ground meat texture across slices

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' look of the glaze. In AI food generation, glazes often look like solid red plastic rather than viscous liquid. Also, check if the internal texture of the meat repeats or looks like noise rather than actual ground muscle fibers.
